title: Country’s Newcomers Take Center Stage in Billboard’s ‘Trending Up’ Series
summary: Meet the new wave of artists pushing it to the center of every country conversation
contentText:
Billboard  News’ Trending Up  series, presented by Sonesta International  Hotels  knows which newer country acts you’ll be singing along to this summer.

In our new episode of Trending Up, we’re spotlighting buzzy acts Dylan Marlowe and Jenna Paulette who are becoming breakouts in the genre and there’s no better time to see them live in concert. First up, we have Dylan, who is playing in Sanford, Florida on July 17th. In addition to the concert, treat yourself to a stay at the neighboring Sonesta ES Suites Orlando – International Drive. The facility offers everything from full kitchens, a heated pool, kids’ amenities, and easy access to some major themes parks.

Jenna Paulette will also be on the road this summer and you can catch her in Nashville on July 29th. Make the most of your time in Tennessee by staying the night at Sonesta Nashville Airport, where guests have access to plenty of amenities, including indoor and outdoor pools and on-site dining.

Stay tuned for more artists to keep on your radar in upcoming installments of Billboard News’ Trending Up, presented by Sonesta International Hotels.
